title: Integral cocycle package for rational Verdier composition
statement: For three finite coefficient fields F, G, H and embeddings i : F →ₐ[Padic l] G and j : G →ₐ[Padic l] H, with Verdier data A, B, C, the ordinary tensor presentations satisfy IntegralFiniteExtension.CompositionConclusion l F G i X D hl wF wG A.ordinary B.ordinary H j wH C.ordinary.

proof.text: Apply the integral comparison cocycle theorem to the F-to-G presentations, using first-variable evaluation naturality, and specialize its final tower to G-to-H with the C presentation and its evaluation naturality.

mathlib_searches.results: The project theorem IntegralFiniteExtension.comparison_cocycles supplies the required package.
